svg.title: SSH Workspace: your agent's commands run on another machine over SSH
svg.desc: The model calls Coder, Shell or FileSystem tools such as run_command and edit_file. SSHWorkspace's get_workspace hook gives the run a remote host as ctx.workspace, so each command and file operation opens an SSH connection with your own ssh client, logs in with a key in BatchMode, and runs on the host as the login user; output comes back to the tool. The WorkspaceRef names the host and directory. A ref from the message history for the same host and directory reattaches; a ref for any other host or directory raises ValueError.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
